Radial orders appear only in NaturalExitParameterJets.lean:60 exists_mixed_jets (for the two coefficient components, hence Φ and u) and in ProfileFamily.mixed_error : UniformMixedError (NaturalAxisBridge.lean:689), which is indexed by both k and m. exists_composed_jets (:79) and exists_quotient_jets (:123), which produce the log Φ and p₁ bounds, are stated at a fixed radius Y.

NaturalExitBounds.exists_exit is Proposition B.3, and it is faithful: entranceSet is [0,4.1]×[-1,1]; Sq, p1, p2, ns, coneSize, regularAngularLag and the NaturalAxisData coefficients reproduce S_q, p₁, p₂, n_s, Q_s, W, H_c, Z_*, L, χ; and the five Estimates clauses are (i)–(v) with strict inequalities and explicit constants (c₀ = 1/8, c_ex = 1/4, c₁ = lowerConstant d, C₁ = B 0), all fixed before Λ and C, in the paper's Λ-then-C₀(Λ) order. The jet constants are uniform in Λ as well as C, which the paper does not claim. The only gap is packaging: the X-derivative half of the final sentence is not among the Estimates clauses, though exists_mixed_jets and ProfileFamily.mixed_error carry the radial orders for Φ and u.
